export.notes: In a real app this runs once and then leaves, so drop the `infinite` and the 82–100% return keyframes and end on `animation-fill-mode: forwards` — the loop-back exists only so the recorded preview cuts cleanly. Remove `.loader` from the DOM once it has finished; a `position: fixed; inset: 0` sheet left in place still costs a full-viewport composited layer even at `pointer-events: none`.
